title: Employers Issued with Warnings, Composition Fines or Charges for Kickback Offences
what_it_is: Employers Issued with Warnings, Composition Fines or Charges for Kickback Offences

sections.label: MOM action against kickbacks
sections.summary: MOM takes stern action against those collecting kickbacks from migrant workers, with enforcement against an average of 102 employers from 2016 to 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) takes stern action against employers or any other party who collect kickbacks from migrant workers as a condition or guarantee of employment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Between 2016 and 2020, MOM took enforcement action against an average of 102 errant employers for collecting kickbacks from migrant workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: On average, there were about five migrant workers affected per employer.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The typical amount of kickbacks paid by migrant workers could range from $1,000 to $3,000.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Once a kickback is being investigated, employers will not be allowed to repatriate the affected workers.

sections.label: Returning kickbacks and data analytics
sections.summary: MOM requires accused to return kickbacks, and uses data analytics to detect unusual hiring patterns and kickback cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: MOM will also require the accused to return the kickbacks collected to these affected workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Between 2016 and 2020, about 20% of the affected migrant workers found new employment and about 30% chose to continue working for their current employer after the kickback issues were resolved.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In recent years, MOM has made use of data analytics to identify and detect unusual patterns in hiring practices to better detect cases of kickbacks.
